guns.design:
CONCEPT: compact bullpup carbine, 5.6 mm class, short-stroke gas piston, semi/auto. The action and the magazine sit BEHIND the pistol grip, so a 700 mm gun carries a 267 mm barrel.
FRAME: same gun space as the CHOPPER and NINE (X forward along the bore, Y left, Z up, metres). ORIGIN ON THE BORE AXIS AT THE REAR FACE OF THE BUTT PAD (in a bullpup the receiver ends at the butt). Muzzle +X. Length 700, height 280 (handle rail top Z +0.100 to magazine floor Z -0.180), width 62 (forend), 80 with the charging handle (left, to Y +0.040) and the deflector (right, to Y -0.043).
BUILD BY SECTION (mm; X from the butt face, Z from the bore):
1 Butt pad: X 0..30, Z -78..+52 (130 high), 38 wide, R 120 in side view, diamond stipple in the normal map, 6 mm heel chamfer, 4 mm lanyard hole in the toe.
2 Rear body (monolithic moulded clamshell, 'blocky'): X 30..395, Z -62..+50 (cheek rise to +56 over X 34..110), 56 wide, 4 mm chamfers on the top edges, vertical flanks with 1.5 mm moulded ribs and a 0.4 mm parting line. Left flank: bolt slot X 300..380 (charging-handle path), selector at X 300, Z -22, hold-open recess. Underside: magazine well opening X 180..232 (52 deep) x 26 wide at Z -62.
3 Forward ejection (right flank): port X 340..400, Z 0..+32; shell deflector = a moulded vane X 395..470 standing 16 mm off the flank, angled 30 deg toward the muzzle, rolled tip; it throws brass forward-right and away from the face. Casing direction (gun space) (0.55, -0.80, 0.25).
4 Integral carry handle (moulded with the body): rear leg X 118..150, front leg X 300..330, 34 wide; bar Z +76..+88 from X 130 to 325; open window 150 x 24 under the bar; accessory rail MI-R on the bar X 160..282 (122 long = 11 slots), lug tops Z +100; rear aperture = 9 mm hole in a 20 mm ring through the rear leg at X 134, Z +60 (SightRear); front sight = tower on the forend nose, X 560..590, post tip X 575, Z +60 (SightFront), two 3 mm guard ears, 2 mm tritium insert in E. Sight radius 441.
5 Forend (blocky, ventilated): X 395..590, Z +34..-40, 62 wide, flat flanks, three rows of four 5 x 14 mm slots per side, 2 mm edge radii. Underside rail MI-R X 455..560, lug undersides Z -52 (grip at X 488, laser at X 536).
6 Barrel X 590..652, R 9.5, with a threaded stub R 8.5 X 652..664 (inside the flash hider; visible when the hider is hidden). Muzzle device = 6-slot birdcage hider X 652..700, R 12.5, bore R 2.8, carbon at the mouth: its own closed shell on bone MuzzleDevice.
7 Pistol grip: top Z -50, bottom Z -172, raked 17 deg; back line (X,Z) (290,-55) (274,-95) (254,-170), front line (342,-55) (316,-95) (292,-172); 33 wide; egg section 42 x 33 at palm height with a 1.2 mm palm swell; finger grooves in the front strap; stipple in the normal map; lanyard hole in the heel.
8 Trigger group: pivot (362, 0, -50); curved steel blade, face X 368 at Z -70; polymer guard loop from the grip front to the forend at X 440, bottom Z -100, 8 x 5 mm D section.
9 Magazine (separate asset SM_Weapon_ShortyMagazine + _TopRound): 24 x 48 mm straight box, 160 mm from MagHinge (206, 0, -20) to the floor plate at Z -180 (30 rounds), olive floor plate with drag tab, visible top round; origin = gun origin (in place, like the CHOPPER/NINE magazines).
FIT RULES (arms, optics and parts depend on them): Palm_R sits on the right face of the grip at its upper middle; trigger face 73 mm ahead of Palm_R (CHOPPER 73, NINE 90); grip to magazine gap >= 20 mm at the bottom (254 vs 230); no part within +-45 mm of Palm_L on the forend underside except the rail; the optic rail is level with the handle bar so SightEye (red dot) lands at Z +124.5 and the eye (relief 0.14) at X +49: above the cheek rise, not inside the body; IronsFront hides when an optic is fitted; the rear ring sits below the optic axis and is out of the field of view.
MODELLING NOTES: lofted sections for the shell (as _weapons_kit.rrect + loft_x), 0.3-1.5 mm chamfers in geometry where >= 0.5 mm, screws and moulded markings in the normal map; INVENTED markings only: 'CARBINE S-5.6', 'SAFE SEMI AUTO', a proof star, serial like 'S2-0417' (no real maker, model, caliber headstamp or logo); keep the rail teeth exact (MI-R) because every optic clamps on them. Triangle plan: body shell 26k, handle + rail 9k, forend + rail 12k, barrel + hider 7k, grip 8k, butt 5k, trigger/guard 4k, bolt + handle 6k, selector/screws/markings 8k, sights 5k, margin 5k = 95k.

CONCEPT: semi-automatic marksman rifle, 7.6 mm class, 1,045 mm overall, 515 mm free-floating barrel, heavy and steady.
FRAME: X forward, Y left, Z up. ORIGIN ON THE BORE AT THE REAR FACE OF THE RECEIVER (stock at negative X, as the CHOPPER's origin is its rear trunnion). Butt X -0.255, muzzle +0.790. Height 198 (cheek riser Z +58 to magazine floor / grip bottom Z -140), width 68 (receiver 44, wrist 52, comb 56, handguard 52, charging knob Y +0.040).
BUILD BY SECTION (mm; X from the receiver rear, Z from the bore):
1 Stock, fixed, dark wood with rubber pads: butt X -255, Z +20..-110 (130 high, 40 wide), R 150 in side view; comb line Z +20 at the butt, +36 at X -240, +52 at X -190, +58 at X -110, +48 at X -40, +40 at the receiver; toe line -110 at the butt, -70 at X -130, -40 at X -50. Cheek riser = stippled rubber pad 80 long x 6 proud on the comb (X -190..-110). Rubber recoil pad 14 mm thick. Sling stud under the toe and on the left. Straight-grain solid wood, NOT the CHOPPER's laminate.
2 Receiver: X 0..235, Z -32..+40, 44 wide, hard 1.5 mm chamfers, left side charging handle (T-knob out to Y +0.040) in a slot X 65..185, selector at X 40 (left), bolt catch lever at X 125 (left), ejection port right X 110..190, Z +4..+30 with a spring dust cover (static), magazine release button right.
3 Top rail (monolithic over receiver and handguard): MI-R, lug tops Z +52, X 0..545 (51 slots at 10.6 pitch), 21.2 wide. Optic socket at X 150. Flip-up back-up irons on the rail: IronsRear at X 28 (aperture 8 mm), IronsFront at X 505 (post 2.5 mm), both tops Z +64.5 (SightRear / SightFront).
4 Pistol grip: top Z -30, bottom Z -140, raked 14 deg; back line (X,Z) (30,-40) (19,-85) (5,-140), front line (85,-40) (74,-85) (62,-140); egg section 40 x 33 at palm height with a palm swell and a stippled panel; trigger pivot (100, 0, -45), blade face X 116 at Z -62 (70 mm ahead of Palm_R); guard from the grip front to the magazine well rear face (X 131).
5 Magazine well and magazine (SM_Weapon_StretchMagazine + _TopRound): well 52 deep x 26 wide, X 131..183, centre X 157; standard 10-round box 24 x 48 mm cross-section, 111 mm from MagHinge (157, 0, -24) to the floor at Z -135, feed lips with a visible top round, steel body with two stamped ribs, black polymer floor plate. (The same 24 x 48 cross-section as the SHORTY so mag_ext_rifle fits both.)
6 Handguard (free-floating): slim round tube R 26, X 225..545, 12 mm bottom rail MI-R X 285..480 (lug undersides Z -38), M-LOK-style slots (invented 'MI slot': 4 x 24 mm) in rows at 3 and 9 o'clock, two 3 mm heat vents; the barrel nut ring at X 225..240.
7 Barrel: R 12.5 bare from X 545 to 715 (free-floating, 170 mm showing); fluted? NO (keep a plain heavy profile with a 0.4 mm step to the thread shoulder). Threaded stub R 8.5 X 715..727 inside the brake.
8 Muzzle brake (MuzzleDevice bone): X 715..790, R 15.5, three ports per side and a top port, bore R 3.5, carbon at the ports; this is the factory device and hides when a suppressor is fitted.
9 Bipod (bone 'bipod'): base clamp X 446..480, Z -38..-56 on the handguard rail; hinge pin axis along Y at (470, 0, -50); two legs, 8 mm tubes at Y +-22, 150 mm long, lying folded BACKWARD under the handguard from X 470 to X 320 at Z -50, feet capped with rubber; deploys by rotating -100 deg about +Y (legs swing down-forward).
FIT RULES: Palm_R on the grip right face upper middle; Palm_L at (0.300, 0, -0.038) = rail underside behind the folded legs (support palm 254 mm ahead of Palm_R); the grip part sits at the same X (Underbarrel 0.300) and replaces Palm_L with SupportHand; legs and grip do not collide (grip body X 285..315, leg tips X 320); the irons (IronsRear, IronsFront) hide when an optic is fitted; scope eye (relief 0.085) lands 21 mm above the cheek riser.
MODELLING NOTES: the stock and handguard are lofts (kit.loft_x, rrect with large radii); the rail is built by one MI-R generator shared with the parts kit (exact teeth, 5.3 mm slots, 45 deg flanks); wood grain and pores live in the texture (3D field like laminate3 but single-plank: ply_normal = Y, no plies); INVENTED markings: 'MARKSMAN 7.6', 'MOD S1', 'SAFE SEMI', a proof star, serial like 'M1-3308'. Triangle plan: stock 18k, receiver 24k, rail 10k, handguard + slots 12k, barrel + brake 9k, grip 7k, trigger group 5k, bolt + handle 7k, bipod 6k, irons 3k, mag well 4k = 105k.

guns.design:
CONCEPT: the Goons' gun in the player's hands: compact open-bolt submachine gun, 9 mm class, semi/auto, 545 rpm. Built on the measured proportions of SM_Weapon_GoonSMG (receiver 270 long, 72 high, bore 42 above the receiver bottom, magazine 42 x 30 x 172, muzzle at 0.465) moved to the origin the data already expects: ORIGIN ON THE BORE AT THE REAR FACE OF THE RECEIVER, muzzle +X (guns.json art note: X_rattler = X_goon + 0.080, Z_rattler = Z_goon - 0.042). Length 465 (folded), 635 (stock deployed to X -0.170), height 271.5 (front-sight tip Z +57.5 to magazine floor Z -214), width 56 (Y -22..+34 with the folded stock).
BUILD BY SECTION (mm; X from the receiver rear, Z from the bore):
1 Receiver: stamped box X 0..270, Z -42..+30, 44 wide, 1.6 mm sheet look: 3 mm bends, seam on the top centre line, spot-weld dimples every 18 mm along the lower edges, two long stamped reinforcement ribs per flank, sling loop at the rear top-left. Right side ejection port X 140..200, Z 0..+24 with the open-bolt face visible; left side: selector lever at (45, +22.5, -14) with S 1 A markings.
2 Top cover and rail: cover X 0..270; MI-R rail X 110..235 (125 long, lug tops Z +42, 12 slots); top charging handle (a T-handle on a stem) on the bolt bone: rest X 80..104, top Z +48, slot X 40..104 in the cover; flip-up rear sight (IronsRear) at X 5..25 (aperture, top Z +57.5, SightRear X 12).
3 Ventilated shroud: round steel tube R 25.5, X 270..410 (140 long), 6 rows x 14 vent holes (5 x 9 mm slots, only the visible 3/4 modelled), end ring; tan strap wrap X 290..350 (2 mm thick, R 27.5, a stitched box and a folded tail tucked under: modelled geometry, not a decal); barrel R 8 inside, R 9.5 visible at both ends.
4 Muzzle device (bone MuzzleDevice): slotted nose X 410..465, R 14.5, three 6 mm slots at 12 mm pitch, bore R 4.5, carbon at the mouth; front-sight tower (IronsFront) on the nose cap X 395..415, post tip X 412, Z +57.5, two 3 mm ears. Threaded stub R 8.5 X 410..422 under the device.
5 Pistol grip: X 30..98 at the top (Z -42), bottom X 36..80 at Z -142, raked 10 deg back; egg section 40 x 32 at palm height, stipple in the normal map, lanyard hole; polymer.
6 Trigger group: trigger pivot (127, 0, -45), blade face X 132 at Z -62 (70 mm ahead of Palm_R); stamped guard loop from the grip front to the magazine well's rear face (X 144), bottom Z -88.
7 Magazine well and magazine (SM_Weapon_RattlerMagazine + _TopRound): well X 144.5..187.5 (43 deep) x 31 wide under the receiver; stick magazine 30 x 42 mm, 182 mm from MagHinge (166, 0, -32) to the floor at Z -214 (32 rounds), two stamped side ribs and a spine, grey steel, black floor plate with a drag tab, visible top round.
8 Wire stock (bone 'stock', rest = FOLDED): hinge on the left rear edge, vertical axis through (0, 28.5, 0); U-frame of two 5.5 mm wires (upper at Z +14, lower at Z -18) 230 mm long, ending in a 70 x 30 x 8 mm butt plate at X 236..256 when folded (top Z +36, so its tab shows over the shroud root in silhouette); deployed (+180 deg about +Z) the butt plate sits at X -170. Latch notch on the receiver's left rear.
FIT RULES: Palm_R on the grip right face; trigger reach 70 mm; Palm_L on the strap wrap's underside (the CHOPPER's palm-up cup, 253 mm ahead of Palm_R); optic = red_dot on the MI-R rail only (the old 70 mm rail was too short); IronsFront and IronsRear hide when an optic is fitted; muzzle parts replace the nose device; no underbarrel and no laser slot (round shroud, no rail).
MODELLING NOTES: the stamped look is the whole character: crisp 1.6 mm sheet edges, bend radii, dimples, a visible butt-welded seam; vents are real holes with inner walls; markings invented ('SMG 9', 'R-545', a proof star, serial like 'R3-0912'). Triangle plan: receiver 20k, cover + rail + handle 10k, shroud with vents 14k, muzzle device 6k, grip 8k, trigger/guard 4k, bolt + port 6k, wire stock 8k, sights 4k, selector/misc 5k = 85k.
